title: Verb 'to be' (am/is/are) / Verb 'to be' (am/is/are)
bridge: En pulaar, mbaanngu e joga: 'wonaa' e 'wonaa'. En ingglis, ko wonaa e joga: 'to be'. E mawnde ma ko ingglis ko wonaa e joga 'ser/estar' e ngonno e ngonno e ngonno, ko ingglis ko wonaa e joga 'to be'. E mawnde ma ko ingglis ko wonaa e joga 'ser/estar' e ngonno e ngonno e ngonno, ko ingglis ko wonaa e joga 'to be'.
rule: Verb 'to be' e ingglis e joga 'to be' e joga 'to be' e joga 'to be' e joga 'to be'. E joga 'am' (e 'I'), 'is' (e 'he, she, it') e 'are' (e 'you, we, they'). E joga 'are you...?', 'Is he...?'. E joga 'not': 'I am not', 'he is not' (ko 'he isn't'), 'they are not' (ko 'they aren't').

common_error.explanation: En pulaar, mbaanngu e joga 'Mi wonaa jom' e joga 'to be' e joga 'to be'. E joga 'to be' e joga 'to be' e joga 'to be'.

examples.note: 'Is' ko e joga e joga e joga.
'Aren't' ko e joga e joga e joga.
E joga e joga e joga e joga e joga.

title: Pronombres Personales (mi, a, o, mo, min, en, be)
bridge: In Spanish, the personal pronouns are similar: yo, tú, él, ella, nosotros, vosotros, ellos. The main difference is that in English, we always use the pronoun as the subject, even when in Spanish it is omitted: 'I am tired' (not just 'am tired'). Also be careful not to confuse 'he' and 'she' — in English they refer to biological gender, not the grammatical gender of the noun as in Spanish.
rule: The personal pronouns in English are: I (yo), you (a/ade/on), he (o), she (mo), it (min), we (en), they (be). 'It' is used for objects, animals, and concepts. 'You' is both singular and plural. The subject is never omitted in English.

common_error.correct: He is a teacher. / She is a teacher.
common_error.explanation: In Spanish they say 'Es profesor' omitting the subject, but in English the pronoun is mandatory. You must always say 'He is...' or 'She is...'.

examples.note: Faɗaɗo e ɗum wuro e dow.
'Min' faa dowɗe, wamii, e dowɗe dowɗe.

title: Articles (a/an, the) / Artículos
bridge: Pular-den e leyɗe e artíkulo: 'a/an' (wurooji) e 'the' (definido). Yettoo keyɗe e Pulaar, wurooji e artíkulo walaa 'the' caggal ngam ngam (muɗum 'Life is beautiful', ko 'The life is beautiful' ko). Ko yettoo, e leɗɗe e yimɓe, wurooji e artíkulo walaa wurooji e artíkulo wurooji e yimɓe: 'I am a teacher' (muɗum 'Soy profesor' ko artíkulo walaa).
rule: Wurooji 'a' wurooji e yimɓe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe. Wurooji 'an' wurooji e yimɓe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe. Wurooji 'the' wurooji e yimɓe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe. Wurooji 'the' walaa wurooji e yimɓe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe.

common_error.explanation: Pular-den 'Soy profesor' ko artíkulo walaa. Inggilisi-den, e leɗɗe e yimɓe, wurooji 'a' ko 'an' wurooji wurooji wurooji.

examples.note: Wurooji 'a' wurooji e yimɓe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe.
Wurooji 'an' wurooji e yimɓe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe.
'The' wurooji e yimɓe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe.
Ko artíkulo walaa wurooji e yimɓe eɗɗe eɗɗe eɗɗe.
